scope: Complete-value source semantics and bounded spelling/grammar review. No native-speaker, whole-catalogue, Android shaping or visual layout acceptance.

ui_assembly_exact_position.review: The exact-fitting idiom yag tag qualifies location; it does not mean all positions or whole image. The official dictionary confirms the idiom meaning and the individual written spellings; the compound UI collocation remains moderate idiomatic confidence.

ui_assembly_target_x.review: X position, from the physical left edge, in pixels. jegün qualifies left edge, not the start of a vertical line. Abbreviated unit phrase after a comma is intelligible; not claimed as a native-preferred wording.

ui_assembly_target_y.review: Y position, from the physical upper edge, in pixels. degedü jaqa specifies the spatial top edge, not reading direction. No coordinate mirroring introduced.

ui_assembly_position_help.source: Set the top-left corner of this image on the output canvas. X and Y are whole pixels, starting at zero. Other images keep their current positions. Overlap is allowed here; images imported later are drawn on top. The canvas expands to include all placed images. Crops and sizes stay unchanged.

ui_assembly_position_nonnegative.review: Both X and Y must be whole numbers starting at zero and through 2147483647. The obligatory yosutai is retained; no negative or fractional value is allowed and zero is not excluded.

ui_assembly_unknown_image.review: The chosen image has ceased to be in this assembly. The reflexive suffix -ban after the vowel-final infinitive bayiqu is supported by written-Mongolian grammar. The cease-being expression is supported by the official dictionary. No deletion, corrupt file, or other unmentioned cause is asserted.

semantic_anchors.meaning: selected image physical top-left on output canvas
semantic_anchors.review: The first clause sets the position of this image’s left-upper corner in the output image area, not its center or a crop handle.

semantic_anchors.meaning: X and Y whole pixel units
semantic_anchors.review: The two variables are integer pixel counts; whole qualifies number rather than an unscaled bitmap.
Other images keep their own current positions; reflexive -iyan follows the consonant-final noun.
Images may overlap here; the permission does not override unrelated controls.
Later-imported images are drawn above earlier images; placement order is separately expressed in the next clause.

semantic_anchors.meaning: canvas includes all placed images by expanding
semantic_anchors.review: The image area expands in order to contain every placed image; this is not scaling the images.
The corrected cutting-result noun denotes cropping in the image context, not intersecting sets.
Both crop and size are governed by the unchanged predicate.

sources.supports: Spelling oγtululta and result-of-cutting noun; corrects two O letters to U. This is not mathematical intersection.
The mathematical whole-number phrase bükhüli toγ-a.
Existential bayiqu and Cyrillic bayikhaa bolikh cease-being construction.
Yag tag exact fitting, without excess or deficiency.
Ozawa, page 1: written-Mongolian reflexive -ban after vowels and -iyan after consonants. Supports both explicit suffix choices; not whole-paragraph idiom.
Research abstract enumerates written-Mongolian passive -γda/-gde. Applying it to the drawing verb is a compositional inference, not a retrieved exact form.
Primary edited written-Mongolian text contains medekü-yin tula: purpose construction. Supports infinitive-genitive plus tula, not identical software wording.
Section 13.5 distinguishes lexical MVS and suffix separation. Unicode 16+ uses MVS; legacy NNBSP retains compatibility support.

idiomatic_confidence: moderate; technical pixel loan and abbreviated unit labels are intelligible but not certified as native preferred

encoding.choice: Retain legacy U+202F separated-suffix boundaries in these values for current Android/font compatibility; lexical U+180E stays unchanged. No blanket conversion to ordinary space or modern MVS.
encoding.probe_scope: HarfBuzz 10.2.0 with exact bundled font: three complete noun/infinitive+suffix examples have nonzero glyphs. NNBSP and MVS shape alike, while ASCII-space substitution changes suffix glyph forms in two examples and spacing in all three. Desktop glyph evidence, not Android pixels.
encoding.source_layout_issue: VerticalText.wrapLabel currently calls cluster.isBlank(), which includes NNBSP, and emits ASCII space. This can destroy suffix glyph context or wrap before the suffix. This is a separate implementation issue and prevents runtime/layout acceptance.
encoding.remaining_uncertainty: Android native raster/layout check for exact complete values remains pending.
